principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for calculating areas of shapes and potentially can be extended to handle different shape types. The SumCalculator class is responsible for both JSON and HTML representation of the area sum. This combines responsibilities that could lead to difficulties in modifying or extending the functionality.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation into its own class that adheres to single responsibility. Also, consider creating separate renderer classes for JSON and HTML outputs.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class needs modifications to support new shape types, violating the open/closed principle as it's not easily extensible without modification.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use polymorphism by creating a common interface for shapes, allowing area calculation without modifying the existing code in AreaCalculator.
